info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Market Information Retrieval API
info.description: The Market Information Retrieval API enables users to access detailed market data relevant to banking operations. It allows consumers to efficiently retrieve information related to various financial instruments and market trends by providing specific parameters. This API is typically utilized by financial analysts, banking professionals, and developers integrating market insights into applications. By harnessing this endpoint, businesses can make informed decisions based on accurate and timely market information.

get.summary: Retrieve market information for a specific resource.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed market data related to the resource represented by ID RES-100045, providing insights into various market metrics and performance indicators.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving market data information. This body should include all necessary parameters to fetch the required market information.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the market information is returned.

GetMarketDataForRes100045Request.description: This schema represents the request body structure for the operation that retrieves market information.

instrumentId.description: The unique identifier for the financial instrument.

dataSource.description: The source from which the market data was obtained.

recordStatus.description: The status of the record, indicating whether it is active, archived, or deleted.

metadata.description: Metadata associated with the market information response.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses a Bearer token as defined in the OAuth 2.0 specification. The token must be included in the Authorization header of requests that require authentication. The expected format is a JSON Web Token (JWT).
